issues.on_page: Local 56,035; p4 (Exhibit D) General column: Charges for Services 47,149, Interest 4,610, Miscellaneous 2,968
issues.issue: Broad 'Local' line put in other, but the report's own General Fund column shows charges for services are 84% of it. Under the extractor rule (more than half, use that category) it should be charges for services/fees with a review note naming the mix. The line also has no category_decision (context label)
issues.resolved: 'Local' is a context label: stays other until the context check (CLAUDE.md 2026-11-05 rule)

issues.on_page: Local 30,340 (Inheritance Tax budget schedule); p4 prints the same amount as 'Inheritance Tax'
